reasoning: This repository is a build and release configuration repository for RHOAI (Red Hat OpenShift AI). It contains no application source code — no operators, libraries, or services. Instead, it holds: (1) build-config.yaml defining container image registry mappings and replacements across all RHOAI components; (2) OLM (Operator Lifecycle Manager) operator bundle definitions including related-image patches, CSV patches, and a scratch-based Dockerfile that assembles the bundle from build args referencing upstream component git URLs/commits; (3) OLM catalog definitions with channel/package configuration for the rhods-operator across multiple OCP versions (v4.19–v4.22); (4) Helm chart configurations for deploying RHOAI on OpenShift and XKS (cross-Kubernetes); (5) CI/CD integration via Tekton pipelines (enterprise-contract verification, integration tests) and build trigger schedules; (6) SBOM metadata configuration mapping environment variables to upstream package versions. It serves as the central build orchestration and release configuration for the entire RHOAI product.
